description: What Claude Code says in place of a reply that didn't come ("API Error: …", or a synthetic message): a line in the error red, aligned with a tool card's text, "API Error" in bold.
opens: An assistant message marked as an API error, or from the <synthetic> model, live or from history

parts.name: line
parts.shows: The message's text in the theme's error colour, wrapping, selectable, 11px in from both sides (where a tool card's text starts). A leading "API Error" is bold, the rest regular: e.g. "API Error: 529 Overloaded".

states.name: stopped turn
states.shows: When you stopped the turn, the CLI's abort words ("Request was aborted.", "This operation was aborted") are not shown as an error: the turn just gets its "interrupted" note.

states.name: retrying
states.shows: While claude retries the API, that's said in the banner above the chat (Banners), not here.
